title: Build the deterministic non-billable provider fixture
statement: Stand up a local provider the pinned runtime can resolve as a custom model, answering deterministically and able to emit a correctly shaped tool call, so the canary and the Stage 1 exchange are testable in CI without a paid account or a network dependency.
notes: ⚠️ COMPONENT WORK LANDED 2026-09-24 (EVD-0140, commit 702ee9c). The fixture is resolved by the pinned runtime as a custom model, completes a real tool call through Pi's CLI, and passes the live canary. ACC-0086 stays open: it needs TSK-0063's journey, which in turn needs TSK-0072 to launch a custom-provider project.
